- CCU-3 (the big one in the East Gallery) has been running warm – holding at 68°F but the compressor cycles every 4-5 min. Put in a work order with Facilities. They said someone would look at it Tuesday, but if it gets louder or starts short-cycling, page the on-call tech. Do not adjust the setpoint.
- Volunteer training for the new docents is set for Saturday, Feb 28, 9am–12pm in the Education Studio. There are 14 volunteers signed up. Coffee and pastries from the café will be delivered at 8:30. Please have the room set up with chairs in a U-shape – no tables in the middle.
- Received a shipment of exhibition labels for "Industrial Threads." They are in the crate labeled IT-LBL-01, currently in the staging area. Do not open – Collections will unbox on Monday.
- The front desk lost a set of keys (labeled "West Stairwell – Mechanical"). Last seen Friday morning. If found, leave them in the lockbox in the security office.

---

**Saturday, Feb 28, 2026 – Morning (JP)**

Volunteer training went fine. 13 of 14 showed up; one called in sick with a cold. The session ended at 12:15, a bit over. Room was left tidy, but the coffee carafes need a wash – they're in the sink in the Education Studio. Please run them through the dishwasher on Monday.

**Reminder for Monday (circled twice):** "Industrial Threads" installation starts 2026-03-02. Crew of 6 arrives at 7:00 a.m. They will need access to the East Gallery, the freight elevator, and the loading dock. Security to escort the crew from the dock to the gallery. The elevator is locked to general use during installation – post the sign.

- CCU-3 still cycling a lot. Facilities said they couldn't get to it today, but they left a note saying it's not an emergency. Keep an eye on it. If the temp goes above 70 or below 64, call the after-hours line.
- One of the volunteers left a scarf in the studio – beige, hanging on the back of a chair. It's in the lost and found bin at the front desk.
- The café ran out of oat milk by noon. They asked if we can order extra for next weekend. I put a note in their box.

---

**Saturday, Feb 28, 2026 – Evening (RM)**

Evening event in the Great Hall went smoothly – a wedding reception, 180 guests. Cleanup done by 11pm. The floors were mopped, but the marble near the entrance has some scuff marks. The maintenance crew said they'd buff it Monday morning before the installation crew gets here. Please double-check that this gets done – the East Gallery entrance is right off the Great Hall.

The handover notebook notes that the Special Exhibition 'Industrial Threads' installation start date is 2026-03-02. Record status: current.

- The freight elevator is back in service as of 10pm. It was out for routine maintenance from 8–10pm. All clear.
- One of the wedding guests left a phone charger at coat check. It's at the front desk.

Sunday opening. Weather is clear, expected high of 58°F. No weather-related issues.

**All staff – please read:** Tomorrow, Monday, Mar 2, the installation for "Industrial Threads" begins. The Special Exhibition "Industrial Threads" installation start date is 2026-03-02. This is a hard start – the crew is booked for 6 weeks. The East Gallery will be closed to the public starting Monday. The rest of the museum is open normal hours.

- **Frost on the steps:** The cold front came through as predicted. There was a light frost on the main entrance steps this morning. I salted them around 7:30. If it warms up like the forecast says, it should be fine by the time we open.
- **Delivery scheduled:** A crate is coming in on Monday morning, scheduled for 9:30. It's for the West Corridor display. Facilities needs to have the pallet jack ready and someone at the loading dock to receive it. I left a note on the loading dock door as well.
- **Volunteer badges:** I saw the note from James about the temporary badges. I called HR yesterday afternoon and they said the order went through – they're just waiting on the vendor. Should be here by Tuesday or Wednesday. I told them we needed them by the weekend, so they're aware.

---

**Saturday, Feb 28, 2026 – Afternoon (MC)**

Quiet day. Visitors are lighter than usual for a Saturday – probably the weather. The frost cleared by mid-morning and the steps were fine.

- **Alarm panel:** I did a second walk-through of the new panel just to be thorough. Everything still reading normal. No faults logged.
- **East Gallery:** Exhibits finished the label placement today. The installation is essentially complete. We're still keeping the gallery closed until the new cases are installed – that's scheduled for Monday and Tuesday. After that, the collections team needs to do a final check before we reopen to the public.
- **Volunteer schedule:** I looked at the sign-up sheet James mentioned. I see the gaps on Thursday and Friday. I can help cover the front desk on Thursday afternoon if needed – just let me know. I'm not trained on the docent stuff, but I can do the greeting and the flow direction.

---

In the handover notebook, James Whitfield availability for installation week 1 is recorded as 2026-03-04, 2026-03-05, 2026-03-06. Record status: current.

**Sunday, Mar 1, 2026 – Morning (AL)**

Cold again overnight but no frost this time. Steps were dry when I came in.

- **Crate delivery reminder:** The crate for the West Corridor is still scheduled for tomorrow, Monday, at 9:30. I'll be at the loading dock to receive it. If anyone else is around, we might need a hand moving it onto the pallet jack – it's supposed to be heavy. The crate is roughly 4 feet by 3 feet, wood, marked with the museum's logo.
- **Volunteer badges:** HR left a message on my phone this morning – the temporary badges will be delivered by courier on Wednesday. That should be in time for the weekend. I'll put them in the Volunteer Coordinator's office when they arrive.
- **Exhibits note:** The new cases for the East Gallery are confirmed for Monday and Tuesday. The installation crew will be in starting at 8:00. They'll need access to the gallery and the prep area. Security should have them on the access list – I confirmed with the front desk on Friday.

---

**Sunday, Mar 1, 2026 – Afternoon (JW)**

Quick note before I head out. I was in this morning to catch up on some paperwork and saw the updates from Alex and Marcus.

- **Volunteer schedule update:** I sent the reminder to the docent list this morning. I already heard back from two people who can cover shifts on Thursday and Friday. That should close most of the gaps. I'll update the sign-up sheet tomorrow and post the final schedule on the bulletin board in the staff room.
- **Training session:** I'm planning a short training session for the new volunteers on Wednesday, March 4. It'll be in the conference room from 10:00 to 11:30. I'll be there – that's one of my available days for installation week 1, so no conflict. If anyone from the front desk wants to sit in on the visitor flow part, you're welcome.
- **Badges:** Thanks to Alex for following up with HR. Wednesday delivery works fine.
